title: Arithmetic Bias in the Distribution of Mersenne Prime Exponents and the Divisor Structure of p-1
summary: The classical Wagstaff heuristic models the primality of $M_p=2^p-1$ primarily through the size of the prime exponent $p$, at the aggregate scale $C\log p/p$. We test whether the divisor structure of $p-1$ produces detectable secondary variation, using $S(p)=\logτ(p-1)/\log\log p$. Known Mersenne-prime exponents $p\ge13$ show systematically elevated values of $S$ relative to nearby prime exponents.
